# BoomOpen Workflow Kit Pro (v5.5.0)

> Production-grade Multi-Agent AI Engineering Orchestration Framework across 5 AI IDEs (Antigravity, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with 17-language natural-language routing, Contract-First 3-Wave sharding, and 12 deterministic CLI compilers & gates.

## Key Telemetry (Synced from Repository Ground Truth)
- **Version**: `v5.5.0` ([GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Kennyboom/BoomOpen-Workflow-Kit-Pro))
- **Supported AI Platforms**: `5` (`antigravity`, `claude`, `codex`, `cursor`, `copilot`)
- **Multilingual NL Routing**: `17` supported locales
- **Deterministic CLI Suite**: `12` CLI commands (`research`, `design`, `plan`, `cook`, `ledger`, `conduct`, `check`, `settings`, `doctor`, `install`, `list`)
- **Slash Commands**: `32` base commands (`84` files: `79` workflows + `5` shared `_ref` protocols) — `/architect`, `/ask` (:fast, :hard), `/auto`, `/autopilot` (:audit, :init, :run), `/brainstorm` (:fast, :hard, :team), `/code` (:fast, :hard, :team), `/conduct` (:council, :pipeline), `/cook` (:fast, :hard, :team), `/debug` (:fast, :hard, :team), `/deep-audit`, `/deploy` (:check, :preview, :production, :rollback), `/design` (:fast, :hard, :team)
- **Specialist Workforce**: `21` specialist agents & `18` Elastic Golden Diamond teams (`72` files: `18` `_team.md` + `54` role specs)
- **Skills Vault**: `1,462` indexed skills (`22` core + `1,440` library across `19` domains)

## Safe Quickstart Installation
```bash
git clone https://github.com/Kennyboom/BoomOpen-Workflow-Kit-Pro.git
cd BoomOpen-Workflow-Kit-Pro
node cli/install.js install antigravity
node cli/install.js doctor
```
